item.title: National Academies Convene Hundreds of Gatherings Annually
item.description:
National Academies Convene Hundreds of Gatherings Annually

The National Academies convene hundreds of gatherings annually.

🔍 Overview

The organization holds events throughout any given year.

🧩 Types of Gatherings

The gatherings include:

  • Conferences
  • Workshops
  • Symposia
  • Forums
  • Roundtables
  • Other gatherings

👥 Attendees

The events attract the finest minds from:

  • Academia
  • The public and private sectors
